CHANGELOG updated in PAPERCRAFT: Real map editor, first pass: apps/mapeditor (offline CLI add/list/remove) places real Paper Engine props into a real, persisted world-objects file apps/server loads at startup. PcSnapshotPacket now broadcasts a real, bounded multi-object list (up to 4). Verified live -- placed 3 real objects, confirmed per-object interact targeting (only the punched object takes damage). bazel build/test //... clean (15 targets, 6/6 mod tests). Commit 14d7e82. (sess-20260825-1938-f6bd411e)
